hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's published Table I

outputs.description: Defect ionization energies and intermediate total energies for C_N and V_N in monolayer BN computed with the charge-corrected jellium model. The verifier recomputes IE from the component energies and compares to the correct reference values.

output_contract.notes: The verifier checks internal consistency by recomputing IE from the reported component energies, then compares the IE to the expected physical values. Only the two defects C_N and V_N are required.

steps.description: Verify internal IE consistency and compare recomputed IE to paper gold within tolerance.
